title: Contra

start.note: At the title screen SELECT toggles 1P/2P (playerMode 0/1); START begins. The AI presses SELECT until playerMode==1, then START.

coachBrief: Contra (NES, 1988, Konami) is a two-player run-and-gun side-scroller. Players advance right (some stages scroll up or are 3D base corridors where you shoot walls until the core opens). A = jump, B = fire; holding UP aims up, DOWN lies prone (shoots low), diagonal aims diagonally. Falling into a pit kills; water is safe (you wade). Enemy bullets kill in one hit; there is no health. Flying weapon capsules (red falcon) give power-ups: S (spread) is best, M (machine gun), L (laser), F (flame), R (rapid), B (barrier/invincibility). Stage 1 Jungle: run right, jump over bushes, destroy the wall sensors at the end. Stage 2 Base: shoot the wall cores from the front, dodge rolling grenades. Stage 3 Waterfall: vertical, climb by jumping between ledges, boss at top. Both players share screen scroll: if one runs far ahead the other is dragged. The AI is player 2; the human is player 1. The AI's job is to be a helpful teammate: keep near the human, cover them, kill threats, never hog the scroll, and let the human lead.
